name: Drunkest Dungeon
detailed_description:
You wake up in the middle of the forest after a rough night. Scratched, bruised, and still a bit drunk. In your pocket – a piece of dry sausage and a small bottle of moonshine. You don’t know what happened, but one thing’s clear: you’ll have to survive. And maybe… do something with that moonshine.

This is a unique 2D RPG with turn-based combat, exploration, and a good dose of rustic humor. Travel through procedurally generated locations, collect ingredients, upgrade your gear, and rebuild your rundown distillery. Face enemies you won’t meet in any ordinary woods – from angry boars to folks who’ve clearly had one too many. Brew custom mixtures by combining moonshine with strange ingredients to gain powerful effects — or just get a bit tipsy.

Core Features:

  • Turn-based combat with a twist – Use quirky skills, gear up with oddball weapons, and fight in a system that doesn’t take itself too seriously.

  • Distillery upgrade system – Rebuild your moonshine base, unlock new recipes, and craft special brews (garlic + booze = vampire repellent?).

  • Tile-based exploration – Discover a new layout with every run. Connect tiles, reveal enemies, win fights, and grab the loot.

  • Resource gathering and crafting – Collect mushrooms, rusty forks, onions, and whatever else the forest gives you. Everything might come in handy.

  • A charming, backwoods world – A mix of forest, village, and forgotten corners of the countryside.

Nothing here really makes sense. Nothing has a clear goal. But if you’ve got a bit of sausage and a bottle in your pocket – you’ll be just fine.

short_description: A turn-based RPG with survival and exploration elements. Play as an amnesiac moonshiner, rebuild your distillery, discover the world, and fight to survive – sometimes with a bottle in hand

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support, Arm64
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 10
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes themes of alcohol use and addiction, presented in a humorous and stylized manner. Alcohol plays a significant role in both the game mechanics and the atmosphere of the world. The player may interact with various substances that affect gameplay.
